reviews_captured_by_me.text: Max and his team members, Slavic and Ivan, were exceptional at what they do.  They updated our shower from fiberglass shell to marble, added a marble accent wall and  replaced our flooring in our master bathroom.  They were talented, hardworking, and so polite and professional.  We faced some challenges during the project, no fault of their own, and they were understanding and flexible.  They also refaced our living room fireplace.  My husband and I had never taken on an endeavor like this before so we were glad to have such an experienced and meticulous team to work with.  I cannot say enough good things about Max and Queen City Renovations LLC.

reviews_captured_by_me.text: We completed our primary bathroom renovation in February, 2026; our second project working with Queen City Renovation. We are thrilled with the results. Key points about Queen City Renovation: 1) They are MASTER craftsmen be it tile, flooring, electrical, and wood, 2) They are respectful of your property. They prepped everything before the job began and cleaned up after the work day concluded, 3) They stayed on budget, and 4) They communicated well with me and gave me solid advice when I asked for it. I look forward to working with them on our next project and you will too.
